summary: E2E for 3 items on AestheticaMD: (1) Patients-list filter persistence via sessionStorage['patients_list_filters']; (2) Inline status change sync between /patients row and /patients/:id detail; (3) NEW bulk survey export /surveys → Wyniki → bulk-export-modal → POST /api/surveys/export-bulk. ALL PASS. Backend pytest 3/3 (test_export_bulk.py). Frontend flows all green: filter persistence via back-button + browser Back; cleared filters stay cleared; sidebar logout clears sessionStorage['patients_list_filters'] and search resets to '' with hidden-statuses-hint visible on re-login; inline status change list→detail (thinking → 'Zastanawia się' on detail-status-badge) and detail→list (awaiting → 'Oczekujący' on row badge, list reloads on mount); Bulk modal shows 3 template chips (NOSE/ROE/SCHNOS) all selected by default, ROE deselect + timepoint 'pre' + status 'planned' → confirm triggered .xlsx download (filename ankiety_zbiorczo_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.xlsx). Backend export-bulk: 200 xlsx with sheets Podsumowanie + NOSE + ROE + SCHNOS; Podsumowanie header exactly [Nazwisko, Imię, Status, Placówka, Zabieg, Data zabiegu, …]; patient_ids restricted to 'Ankieta Anna' → exactly 1 data row with matching last_name. Regression: /surveys templates tab still lists all 3 presets.

issues: Minor race: the results-counter briefly shows 'Wyświetlono: 0 z 0' immediately after navigating back via back-button because loadData() is still in flight (patients state is empty for a tick). State itself (search, sort_by, sort_order, chip) is correctly restored from sessionStorage. Cosmetic only — could be masked by rendering counter only when !loading.

critical_code_review_comments: PatientsList.jsx: FILTERS_KEY persistence effect writes on every change — clean. Restored via loadSavedFilters() at useState init — good; no flicker. Consider gating results-counter behind !loading to avoid the transient '0 z 0' after back-nav.
AuthContext.logout(): correctly clears 'patients_list_filters' and 'surgery_confirm_*' keys from sessionStorage — verified.

BulkExportModal.jsx: templates default-selected; timepoints union recomputes as templates toggle; export uses responseType:'blob' + filename parsed from Content-Disposition — solid. Minor: when no templates selected, handleExport toasts and stops before request — good UX.

surveys.py export_bulk: correct location filter propagation via get_patient_location_filter for RBAC; sheet titles truncated to 30 chars (Excel limit); Podsumowanie header order matches spec. Sub-scales expanded per timepoint per template.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (persistence, browser-back, cleared, logout-clears, status list↔detail, bulk export download)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test patient via API for status-sync flow (id df713bf0-…), deleted at end of that script. Also test patients from backend pytest (TEST_ prefixed) created & deleted in same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter persistence key is sessionStorage['patients_list_filters'] (fields: searchQuery, statusFilters, procedureFilters, locationFilter, asapFilter, sortBy, sortOrder). Logout drops it. On login, /dashboard opens a 'Czy zabiegi się odbyły?' modal — dismiss via 'Przypomnij później' before other UI interactions. Bulk export download filename pattern: ankiety_zbiorczo_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.xlsx. Preset codes: NOSE, ROE, SCHNOS (3 templates).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the requested features.
